(c) Disconnect the throttle cable from the cam.
(d) Remove the valve body.
REMOVAL HINT: Be careful not to drop the check ball body and spring.
INSTALLATION HINT:
• Install the body together the check ball body and spring.
• Align the groove of the manual valve to the pin of the lever.
